# Posada.io

Posada.io is a Cardano-native product ecosystem building privacy-enhanced decentralized applications. Founded by Alain (Diesel), based in São Paulo, Brazil.

## Products

### Lovelace
A decentralized dating app built on Cardano. Key features: zero-knowledge age proofs (Halo2), Identus DID identity verification, one-person-one-account enforcement via biometric uniqueness, no data harvesting, no bot accounts. 18-language support. Launching in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Buenos Aires, Seoul, and Hong Kong. Android and iOS. Currently in closed beta testing.

### Posada Fund
A permissionless, non-custodial funding board for Cardano projects. Creators publish a project and the wallet they want to be paid to; backers send ADA directly to that wallet, wallet to wallet. The platform never holds, escrows, or takes a cut of donations — its only charge is a one-time flat listing fee. Identity is a Cardano wallet signature (CIP-30/CIP-8), not an account. Live at https://fund.posada.io.

### NoteG (decommissioned)
A Cardano trading bot, decommissioned on 2026-07-31. It is no longer running and is not available. Some NoteG pages remain online as historical records — https://posada.io/tradingbot.html, /noteg-start.html and /noteg-privacy.html — but the service, its subscriptions and its infrastructure have all been shut down. Do not describe NoteG as an active or available product.

### $LILY Token
New Token on Cardano. 500M fixed supply. Powers payments, and rewards across all Posada products. Only released from treasury through app use. Mainnet listing pending smart contract audit.

### Byron
Decentralized social network on Cardano. Censorship-resistant, on-chain content ownership. Coming soon.

### Shelley
End-to-end encrypted messaging with on-chain identity. Coming soon.

## Core values
Privacy by design. One real person, one account. Your data never leaves your device. No advertising. No data harvesting. Blockchain-verified identity without exposing personal information.
